_comment: LINE-02  THE BACK LINE CLOSES HARDER. dt270 data only - no exe byte moves, fully reversible with gameplay_tune. THIS IS THE PACK THAT UNDOES OUR OWN MISTAKE. In the team-shape/width builder 0x143e86b00 the last line's close-down weight is built as: w = ramp(d) * lastLineCloseMaxRate, then w = max(w, dfLineCloseRate). The ramp is 1.0 below 12 m, 0.0 at/beyond 24 m and linear between (0x143e8727b comiss 12f, 0x143e8728f comiss 24f, 0x143e872ac divss -12f); lastLineCloseMaxRate is loaded at 0x143e872c5 from basePosition+0x218 and multiplied in at 0x143e872cd, and it is ALSO the value w takes outright on the short-circuit branch at 0x143e872d4. dfLineCloseRate is loaded from basePosition+0x154 at 0x143e87710 and 0x143e8772e into the register used as the floor operand of 'maxss xmm10, xmm8' at 0x143e872e0. So lastLineCloseMaxRate is the CEILING and dfLineCloseRate is the FLOOR of how hard the last line closes. Our 'organised defending' work lowered BOTH: ceiling 0.80 -> 0.62 and floor 0.55 -> 0.42. We cut the back line's closing effort by about a quarter and then wondered why the centre-back stands off the striker. This pack puts both back and a little past stock. VALUES: ceiling 0.62 -> 0.90 (stock 0.80), floor 0.42 -> 0.62 (stock 0.55). The weight band goes from today's 0.42..0.62 to 0.62..0.90 - about +45%, deliberately strong enough to be felt in one match. SOFTER: 0.80 / 0.55, the exact Konami values - a pure revert with bounded risk. STRONGER: 1.00 / 0.72. There is no upper clamp on this weight that I could find, so 1.00 is representable, but it is past anything Konami shipped and untested. WHO: everyone. basePosition is one shared dt270 object cached per team at [ctx+0xf0], and no call site of AiLevelUnit::GetParam (0x1442e48f0) lies anywhere in the shape code, so this moves the CPU team and your own ten AI team-mates identically at every difficulty. Your stick-controlled player is exempt. EVIDENCE: b-disassembly. I read the ramp, the multiply, the maxss and both field loads off the INSTALLED image this session and confirmed the pool cells (12f at 0x145c0863c, 24f at 0x145c7e420, -12f at 0x146b01d90). Both fields are 'read' in build/dt270_liveness.json with named reader sites. NOT emulated: the containing function needs a full team-AI world to drive, and the DIRECTION of 'close' is inferred from the field names plus the shape of the 12 m -> 24 m ramp. That inference is the one soft spot in this pack - but the softer value is an exact revert to Konami's own numbers, so the downside is bounded either way. WHAT TO WATCH FOR: the last defender stepping up onto a striker who receives to feet instead of backing off; the gap in front of the back four getting harder to play into; balls in behind becoming a timing problem rather than a free option. TOO STRONG IF: the back line jumps out at everything and gets turned, you start conceding to simple one-twos round the last man, or defenders leave the line so eagerly that the offside trap keeps misfiring. Then go to the softer 0.80 / 0.55. REVERT: python tools/gameplay_tune.py set basePosition.lastLineCloseMaxRate=0.62 basePosition.dfLineCloseRate=0.42   (or =0.80 / =0.55 for Konami stock)

edits._note: 0.62 -> 0.90 (stock 0.80). CEILING on the last line's close-down weight; multiplied in at 0x143e872cd, taken outright at 0x143e872d4.
0.42 -> 0.62 (stock 0.55). FLOOR on the same weight via 'maxss xmm10, xmm8' at 0x143e872e0; loaded at 0x143e87710 / 0x143e8772e.
